name: V2X-Sim 2.0 mini · scene_5 · Town03 intersection
citation: Li et al., V2X-Sim: Multi-Agent Collaborative Perception Dataset and Benchmark for Autonomous Driving, IEEE RA-L 2022

ortho.method: stitched from the 4 road-side cameras via their ground homographies (median over frames, road users masked); gaps filled from the vehicles' cameras with simulator poses

map.method: majority vote of the dataset's ground segmentation projected through every camera's calibration
